elements.name: Aarakocra
elements.desc: Aarakocra is a language your character can speak, read and write. It includes clicks, trills, and whistles that other peoples have difficulty pronouncing.

elements.name: Auran
elements.desc: Auran is the language of the Elemental Plane of Air, a dialect of Primordial. It is a language your character can speak, read and write.
